newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat mixed on stg moves, abundant old crop.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat mixed on stg moves, abundant old crop.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended mixed after a subdued day's trading.
An easier sterling helped it to highs, but the old crop was hit by sentiment that supplies are abundant. "There's still plenty of old crop out there," one trader said.
Volume was low at a total 272 lots. "It's pretty pathetic compared with what we have been doing," he said.
Old crop ended lower, with July, the day's most active contract, last traded 0.50 stg down at 91.00 stg per tonne, July's volume was 142 lots.
New crop months firmed, with November last traded 0.30 stg higher at 94.30 stg. Volume on November was 64 lots.
In barley, 39 lots changed hands, all on November, which last traded 0.50 stg higher at 91.50 stg.
Sterling/mark eased in afternoon Europe, slipping below 2.78 marks, in comparison with a peak of over 2.79 marks.
